description: Reseller and DoD orders received in the ERP from the portal, EDI, phone, and email; credit checks; allocation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $216K revenue and 650 order lines per shipping day; resellers expect next-day shipment and move orders to competing distributors after one day
manual_workaround: Order log spreadsheet and paper order forms; key into the ERP after restore; call top 20 resellers
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; portal vendor; EDI network provider; ISP
dependent_people_or_facilities: 14 sales and account managers; 4 customer service; headquarters office

description: Pick, pack, label, and ship about 220 shipments per day with the WMS and 40 handheld scanners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Carrier pickups close each afternoon; DoD delivery dates in Prime A and Prime C orders; the WMS holds bin locations and pick status. Nightly WMS backups can only deliver a 24 h RPO
manual_workaround: Print pick tickets from the ERP; paper pick and pack; labels from the carrier web portal; reconcile inventory in the WMS after restore
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01; SYS-07; SYS-11; SYS-08; SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Carriers; shipping label service; cloud provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: 22 warehouse and logistics staff; distribution center and dock

description: Self-service catalog, pricing, ordering, order status, and invoices for about 1,100 reseller users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 40% of order lines arrive through the portal; two large resellers require availability commitments (P09)
manual_workaround: Take orders by email; phone; or EDI through customer service
dependent_third_parties: Portal vendor; portal payment page provider

description: Purchase orders to 47 suppliers by EDI and email; approved supplier list; forecasting and suggested orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Fast-moving SKUs hold 3 to 5 days of stock cover; DoD orders must follow the DFARS 252.246-7008 sourcing order even during an outage
manual_workaround: Manual purchase orders from the ERP reorder report or a spreadsheet; buy only from authorized sources while systems are down; no broker purchases
dependent_third_parties: Authorized distributors and OEM programs; EDI network provider; forecasting vendor

description: Receive inbound shipments; check quantities, serial numbers, seals, and authenticity; quarantine suspect items; cycle counts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inbound trucks can be held about 2 days before dock space runs out; skipped inspection under time pressure raises counterfeit and tampering risk (R-001)
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log with serial capture; hold all broker receipts in quarantine until systems return
dependent_people_or_facilities: Receiving team; Warehouse and Logistics Manager; dock

description: Stage and configure switches and video equipment for Prime B using CUI configuration documents; custom kitting and asset labels for Prime A and Prime C
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 6 Prime B jobs per month with delivery schedules measured in days; CUI must be restored only to the controlled CUI share and lab workstations
manual_workaround: Pause configuration jobs and notify Prime B; no alternate location for CUI; kitting continues on paper for FCI orders
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (file server CUI share); SYS-09 (6 lab workstations); SYS-08; SYS-10 (lab cage); SYS-05

description: Order status; returns authorization; warranty claims with OEMs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Return and warranty windows are measured in weeks; customers expect status answers the same day
manual_workaround: Answer status by phone from the last ERP export; log returns on paper

description: Invoicing; cash application; supplier payments; supplier bank-detail changes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.08M invoiced per week; supplier payment terms tolerate a few days; bank-detail changes are a fraud target (R-003)
manual_workaround: Delay invoicing; pay urgent suppliers through the bank portal with call-back verification of bank details

business_process: Government contract compliance and incident reporting
description: SPRS entries; CMMC affirmations; Section 889 representations and reports; DIBNet cyber incident reports; notices to primes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reporting clocks: 72 hours for DFARS 252.204-7012(c) cyber incidents and 1 business day for FAR 52.204-25(d) covered equipment reports
manual_workaround: Report from a clean laptop with the medium assurance certificate (not yet obtained); phone the prime and contracting officer
dependent_third_parties: DoD (DIBNet); Prime A; Prime B; Prime C
dependent_people_or_facilities: Government Contracts Manager; Chief Executive Officer (Affirming Official)

description: Time capture; payroll; onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
